lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，不快不慢。
lines.en: I follow behind you, neither fast nor slow.
My claws land lightly.
I keep to your right.
There is a ring mark on my neck.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，走路不碍事。
lines.en: Wings folded, they do not hinder my walk.
I go ahead and sniff.
I need no leash.

lines.zh: 你一停，我的爪子就收住。
lines.en: You stop; my claws stop.

lines.zh: 我跟你走，是因为我愿意。
lines.en: I follow because I choose to.

lines.zh: 我回头看你有没有跟上。
lines.en: I look back to check you are coming.
We walk this stretch in silence.

lines.zh: 我踩过落叶，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I cross the leaves as quietly as I can.

lines.zh: 我在你身后半步的地方。
lines.en: I keep half a step behind you.

lines.zh: 我坐在你旁边，翅膀收好。
lines.en: I sit beside you, wings folded.

lines.zh: 我用指环换过几次状态。
lines.en: I have changed modes with the ring a few times.
I wait for your gesture.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我小时候大了。
lines.en: This body is bigger than when I was young.
I lower my head and nudge your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我听得见你很远的声音。
lines.en: I can hear you from far off.

lines.zh: 我在你旁边的时候不紧张。
lines.en: I am not tense when I am beside you.
I curl my tail at my feet.

lines.zh: 你手放在我背上，我就安静。
lines.en: When your hand is on my back, I am calm.
I am memorizing your scent.
I can take off at any moment.

lines.zh: 这枚指环，我认得它的重量。
lines.en: I know the weight of that ring.
You are back at last.
I have been waiting here.
Raise your hand and I understand.

lines.zh: 我比你高，但我不会压你。
lines.en: I am taller, but I will not press you.
Your sleeve smells of dragon scale.
Which way today?

lines.zh: 我可以跟着，也可以留下。
lines.en: I can follow, or I can stay.
Do not push. I understand.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看你手上的指环。
lines.en: I look up at the ring on your hand.
Do you want me to fly?
I lower my neck for you to touch.
I will not go too far.

lines.zh: 我脖子歪了歪，等你说话。
lines.en: I tilt my neck, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你手上那枚指环，是我的记号。
lines.en: That ring on your hand marks me.
I do not want to fly today. Only walk.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，挡在你前面。
lines.en: I give half a step, still in front of you.
A scale has lifted from my shoulder.
I cry out, low.
My blood is hot enough to smoke.
A scale is gone; it will grow back.
Get behind me.
I raise my claw anyway.
Do not worry about me.

lines.zh: 戒指一转，我就跟着你飞。
lines.en: One turn of the ring and I fly with you.
Is that meat in your hand?
I will eat, but first I look at you.
You need not hold it so high.
I want another piece.
This tastes good.
I leave the last piece for you.

lines.zh: 那东西闻着不错，给我看看。
lines.en: That smells good—let me have a look.

lines.zh: 主人，你手里的是给我的吗？
lines.en: Master, is that for me?

lines.zh: 我比你重，但我退了一步。
lines.en: I am heavier, but I gave a step.
I go around. I will not step on you.
That nearly toppled you.
My scales are very slick.
I steady myself against your shoulder.
Do not stand beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 青铜色的鳞，配我的鞍正好。
lines.en: Bronze scales suit my saddle.
I am not angry. Do not worry.
Another bump is fine.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不需要别的同类。
lines.en: I follow you. I need no other kin.
My kind are in the ruins.
The ring answers you, not me.
That would mean returning to the ruins.

lines.zh: 你站在这里，我就站在这里。
lines.en: You stand here; I stand here.
Do not send me away.
My life is longer than you think.
I would rather hold this spot.
You understand what I mean.
I pick up a scale.
I shed it; I keep it.
I carry it to you in my mouth.
This is too heavy.
Take it home and hang it on your wall.
This egg is not a drakvyrn's.
Let me carry that back for you.
I'll pick up what fell with my claws.
Whoever moves on you answers to me.
One step at this distance.
I half-open both wings.
Fire is gathering deep in my throat.
Deep in my throat, fire is gathering.
It is watching the two of us.
My head is already lowered.
It did not step back.
Then I go in.
Stay right here.
The ring chimes and I count to three.
This is me counting one.

lines.zh: 它往侧面绕，我抬高一边翼。
lines.en: It circles wide; I lift one wing.
My wings stay spread.
I will not let it near you.
It backed off a little.
My throat is hot.
Get to the wall.
Its steps fall one by one.
I come around and block it.
It has stopped in place.
Then I strike first.
Call me and I will return.
Only this last one left.
I pin it, claw tips first.
I hold in front of you and do not flinch.
My teeth take it.
The fire leaves my throat.
This charge pushes it away.
It struck my scales. Nothing.
You stay behind me. Do not move.
Bronze scales, carrying my rider.
This blow is for you.
It has run far off.
Do you want me to chase it?
No chase. Back to your side.
I rise beside you.
The ring flashed once.
I shake the dust off my back.
I am a little bigger than you remember.
First I look at you, then around.
Your scent is here.
I lower my head to your hand.
You raise a hand. I know it.
Raise your hand and I follow.
I need not learn you again.
I take my place at your right.
We start from here.
The ring is still on your hand.
I settle and wait for your signal.
This time I keep close.
You walk, and I walk.
I will not be lost.
Then we set out.
Fire is only warmth. I am fine.

lines.zh: 我落地时砸出坑，翅膀撑了一下。
lines.en: I land in a crater, wings breaking the fall.
Water floods my throat and the fire dies.
The blast shoves me ahead of you.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的肩鳞里。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shoulder scales.
A chill slips under the scale roots.
I am hungry, but I can still fly.
Lightning rolls down my back.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我张开了翅膀。
lines.en: No ground below; I spread my wings.
